description: Quote all supported non-annuity products: term, non-med term, return-of-premium term, final expense (fex), UL, accumulation IUL (iul), protection IUL (piul), VUL where enabled/licensed, whole life, linked benefits, traditional LTC, and accidental death. Supports LTC/chronic illness riders on life products. Call get_life_quote_requirements first for enabled products and each product's schema/health labels. Use explicit user inputs. Returns consumer product details, comparison benefits, exam/application guidance, illustration values when available, and signed quote_id selections for create_life_eapp. Annuities are excluded.

health.description: User-supplied assumed health value. Get product-specific labels from get_life_quote_requirements. Never infer underwriting eligibility.
